title: New node update made image selection worse
body:
Hi, I had to update the previous node because it wasn’t selecting images properly, but to my surprise, this new version has several issues compared to the old one.

First, if I have multiple tabs open and I close one of them for any reason, the selection gets canceled.

Second, the new image selection window doesn’t allow zooming with the mouse wheel like the previous one did. That makes it really hard to select something with precision, especially when you're looking for very subtle differences.

Third, I can work around it by using a preview image before selecting, which helps a bit—but it's a worse experience overall compared to just selecting directly like before. And to do this, I have to use the "small window" option. The problem is that once it opens, I can’t minimize it again if I notice something new or realize I missed something. You're forced to either select or cancel, and canceling makes me lose my work and regenerate everything again using the same seed.
author: locsmax

comments.body:
First is a known issue ( #39 ).

For the rest - I assume you are aware that if you press the space bar while hovering over an image in the chooser it will magnify that image to allow you to look at it?

You can also right-click and open an image in a new browser tab.

If these aren't enough to solve your problem, I suggest you open a new issue - but I suggest you frame it as a feature request rather than a complaint. 

Something like "Could we have some way to zoom in on details of the images? Maybe the scroll wheel could zoom?"

I have a limited amount of time to spend on custom nodes, and I do it for fun. So which do you think is more fun to respond to, "hey, here's an idea for a cool feature!" or "it's worse than X"?

title: Where is "Progress with selected image(s) as restart"?
body:
Hello!

I loved the preview chooser node you made, probably the node I've used the most!

The problem is the previous node worked perfectly and this one is lacking two main useful things: "progress with selected image(s) as restart" and the easy look and selection directly on comfyui screen without popups, huge or small; it's a better UX when less visually invasive.
Or maybe I'm missing the "progress selected image(s) as restart" button somewhere?

Thank you!

title: Multiple re-tries
body:
Hello, since image picker stopped working as expected (see my issue post under it's git), I am looking into this one:
Several questions:

1) If i has chosen one of X images, how can I choose another if i dont like the result? Doing an inpainting with multiple variations.
In image picker it was working (up to its latest update) where i was able to pick one result from the set, then if i dont like - i pick another etc. Here i kind of not get this. Under settings it also has enabled the option for clicking "!" to re-show the window, though nothing happens.

title: Retain in-node optionality vs popup
body: Hey there, is there any consideration to allowing users to pick having images displayed within the image filter node instead of having a popup every time? I quite liked the in-node functionality of image-picker, which I know you've discontinued support for. It would be nice to have the option to either use the pop-up or have images displayed within the node for selection.

title: [Feature] Some mechanism to zoom one of the images
labels: Probably going to do this soon
body:
For an eight image batch selecting the best image looking at details is hard.
Some option to use all the screen for an image we choose could help.
I.e. I want to generate various images and discard the ones with bad hands. But I must be able to zoom the hands for any of the images.

comments.body: In 1.1.6 I've added a zoom feature - hover over one of the images (it gets highlighted in red) and press space. Press space again to close the zoom.
